description: Fork of exp157 (hard-fwd STE, val_bpb=2.18 @ step 1000 — slow learning vs exp154/156). Replace learnable attn_scale with FIXED high value to make A_soft (gradient surrogate) close to A_hard (forward). fixed_attn_scale=3.0 → effective_scale = 3.0 / sqrt(496) ≈ 0.135. From exp144 analysis: median top1-top2 popcount gap = 12 (score gap 24). With this scale, top1/top2 softmax ratio at median row ≈ exp(3.24) ≈ 25 → top1 carries ~95% mass — soft is nearly hard. Hypothesis: STE mismatch was the cause of slow learning in exp157, not hard attention itself. If exp158 reaches val_bpb≈1.71, hard attention is viable.
